grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings (2 critical RCE CVEs + 1 spec-drift) exceed grade C threshold (max_p1: 2). Spec coverage 24% below grade C minimum of 40%. Specifications/ directory coverage is 0%.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (RCE)
escalations.impact: Remote Code Execution — arbitrary JS execution in template rendering context
escalations.escalation_reason: RCE vulnerability — requires security team to verify template usage and exploitability

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution via Untrusted Deserialization
escalations.impact: Remote Code Execution — arbitrary code via malicious .proto files or serialized messages
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm install protobufjs@latest  # solo-session only
escalations.escalation_reason: Critical RCE in orchestration tier — highest-privilege component

escalations.title: form-data — CRLF Injection via Unescaped Multipart Field Names
escalations.escalation_reason: Injection vulnerability — requires security team verification of multipart usage

escalations.title: vite — Path Traversal in Optimized Deps .map Handling
escalations.impact: Source code disclosure via source map path traversal

escalations.title: postcss — XSS via Unescaped </style> in Stringify Output
escalations.impact: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via unescaped CSS output
escalations.escalation_reason: XSS vulnerability — security team must verify CSS processing pipeline

escalations.title: @remix-run/router — Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
escalations.impact: Open redirect — attackers redirect users to attacker-controlled domains
escalations.escalation_reason: Open redirect — requires security team to verify redirect validation

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Malformed Request Causes Server Crash (CVSS 7.5)
escalations.impact: Denial of service — gRPC server crash via protocol abuse
escalations.escalation_reason: Server crash via gRPC protocol abuse — TheGuardians to verify hardening

findings.title: Specifications/ directory has 0% implementation coverage — 74 FR IDs untraced
findings.detail: 74 unique FRs in the primary spec have zero // Verifies: traces in Source/. Enforcer gives false green because it only scans Plans/self-judging-workflow.
findings.recommendation: Declare spec as PLANNED or open implementation plans. Extend traceability-enforcer.py to scan Specifications/.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer scope does not cover Specifications/
findings.detail: Enforcer auto-discovers only the most recently modified Plans/*/requirements.md. The 74 FRs in Specifications/ are invisible — enforcer reports 100% while true coverage is 24%.
findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan Specifications/*.md. Add --all-specs mode or consume inspector.config.yml specs.dir setting.

findings.title: Direct store calls in route handlers violate service-layer rule
findings.detail: Three route files call store.* directly from Express handlers, bypassing the service layer. Architecture rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
findings.recommendation: Extract WorkItemService wrapping store calls. Routes call service methods only.

findings.title: GET /api/search not implemented — 5 test cases will fail
findings.detail: search.test.ts documents FR-dependency-search but the route is absent from app.ts. Plans/dependency-linking marks it Done — but that refers to portal/Backend, not Source/Backend.
findings.recommendation: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts. Route through WorkItemService.

findings.title: Plans/dependency-linking tracker is stale — wrong paths, wrong status
findings.detail: Tracker was written for portal/ paths. Active code is in Source/. Marks items as Missing that exist in Source/Frontend; marks portal/Backend search as Done (it's missing from Source/Backend).
findings.recommendation: Update tracker to reflect Source/ paths. Reconcile status column. Establish convention for which codebase each plan targets.

findings.title: brace-expansion — multiple DoS vulnerabilities (CVSS 7.5)
browserslist — unbounded memory growth
js-yaml — quadratic-complexity DoS via repeated aliases in merge keys
ws — uninitialized memory disclosure
nanoid — non-secure generators loop indefinitely with negative size
@vitest/mocker — path traversal / arbitrary file read (dev dependency)
eslint-disable-next-line without documented justification
findings.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without rationale in 2 files. Indistinguishable from mistakes.
findings.recommendation: Add one-line comment explaining intentional suppression reason.

findings.title: Silent error swallow in API client catch block
findings.detail: response.json().catch(() => ({})) silently drops JSON parse failures. Violates 'never swallow errors silently' rule.
findings.recommendation: Add debug log or architectural comment explaining intentional suppression.

findings.title: @babel/core — arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (dev)
baseline-browser-mapping — process termination on invalid input
body-parser — DoS via invalid limit value disables size enforcement
@protobufjs/utf8 — accepts overlong UTF-8 encodings
glob — deprecated with widely publicized security vulnerabilities
inflight — deprecated with memory leak, replace with lru-cache
findings.fix: npm uninstall inflight && npm install lru-cache

findings.title: superagent & supertest — deprecated (v10.2.2+ / v7.1.3+)
multer 1.x — deprecated, upgrade to 2.x
